title: Corporate/Commercial Legal Secretary/Assistant - York

Interested? Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Legal Secretary
description:

You will become an important part of the team, helping to keep files organised, deadlines on track and clients fully informed throughout their transactions.

- Providing efficient secretarial and administrative support to fee earners and the wider legal team

- Liaising professionally with clients, colleagues and external contacts by telephone and email

- Supporting diary management, meetings, billing, time recording and other administrative processes

We are looking for someone who takes pride in delivering excellent work and enjoys being part of a busy, collaborative legal environment.

- Previous experience in a Legal Secretary or similar legal support role

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Good IT skills, with the ability to quickly learn and use case management systems
- A proactive, reliable and solutions focused approach
- A genuine team player who takes ownership and pride in their work
- Committed to delivering a professional and positive client experience

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is dependable, commercially aware and enjoys being part of a busy team where their contribution is valued.

What Our Client Offers
In return, you'll join a professional and supportive working environment where your contribution is valued and there are opportunities to develop your career.
- Salary of £26,000 - £28,000 per annum
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays

- Auto-enrolment pension scheme
- Modern, well situated offices
- A friendly, supportive and professional working environment
- Opportunities for career progression within the Practice

- Private healthcare
- Opportunities to get involved in charity initiatives

In return, you will join a well established and successful business that is committed to investing in its people. You'll receive a competitive salary of £26,000 - £28,000 per annum depending on experience, structured training, ongoing professional development and genuine opportunities to progress your career within a supportive and collaborative team. APPLY TODAY!

Our Guarantee

title: Legal Secretary/Paralegal - Commercial Property
description:
Paralegal - Commercial Property
- Salary: £25,000 - £30,000
- Location: York
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a dedicated Paralegal to join our Commercial Property Department. This role involves a blend of fee-earning and administrative responsibilities, ensuring the efficient delivery of legal services. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and possess excellent organisational and communication skills, capable of effectively coordinating between clients and internal teams.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Legal Expertise and Transactional Responsibilities:
- Support fee earners in providing legal advice on commercial property matters, including lease negotiations, property acquisitions, and disposals.
- Draft, review, and negotiate legal documents under supervision, ensuring alignment with clients' commercial objectives.
- Assist in conducting due diligence, identifying potential risks, and advising on mitigation strategies.
- Coordinate transactions from inception to completion, ensuring timely progress.
- Fee-Earning and Casework:
- Assist with fee-earning activities under supervision, managing own caseload where possible.
- Draft legal documents and correspondence.
- Review and organise documents provided by clients or third parties.
- Prepare case-related financial records and assist with the distribution of funds.
- Administrative and Support Services:
- Provide administrative support including typing, diary management, and general office duties.
- Manage filing systems, correspondence, and document handling.
- Client Communication and Representation:
- Maintain professional client interactions, ensuring confidentiality and discretion.
- Respond promptly to client queries and support the processing of client instructions in line with firm procedures.
- Teamwork and Professional Development:
- Actively contribute to the team, organise and prioritise workloads, and engage in ongoing training to enhance legal knowledge and skills.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2+ years' legal secretarial experience; full training will be provided.
- Fast and accurate audio and copy typing skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Word and Excel.
- Experience with legal case management software (e.g., Partners for Windows) is advantageous.
- Strong English grammar, spelling, legal terminology familiarity, and numerical skills.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to manage confidential information discreetly.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities as required.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Supportive team environment focused on continuous improvement and high standards.

If this is of interest don't hesitate in applying.

title: Paralegal - Family
company: Capital Outsourcing Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Family Care Paralegal

Make a difference. Build your career. Be part of a team that cares.

Are you a Paralegal looking to build your career in Family Law? Do you want a role where your work has a genuine impact on people's lives?

We're looking for a Family Care Paralegal to join a busy, supportive and dedicated Family Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your experience in Family Care and public law children matters, working alongside experienced Solicitors and Legal Advisers on a varied caseload including care proceedings and pre-proceedings work.

You'll play an important role in supporting clients through what can often be some of the most challenging and sensitive periods of their lives. Alongside gaining valuable legal experience, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your technical skills and grow your career within a specialist area of law.

What's in it for you?

We believe that great people deserve great benefits. In return for your hard work and commitment, you'll enjoy:
- Hybrid and flexible working - giving you greater choice over how you work.
- 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays
- Your birthday off - because everyone deserves a day to celebrate.
- Death in Service scheme
- Healthcare cash plan
- A supportive team environment where your development and progression are encouraged.
- The opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience in a specialist area of Family Law.

What will you be doing?

No two days will be exactly the same. You'll work closely with Solicitors and Legal Advisers, helping to keep cases moving and ensuring clients receive the high standard of service they deserve.

Your role will include:
- Supporting Solicitors and Legal Advisers with Family Care matters, including care proceedings and pre-proceedings work.
- Providing professional, empathetic and client-focused support to clients facing sensitive and challenging circumstances.
- Drafting correspondence, legal documents, witness statements, chronologies and applications.
- Liaising with clients, Courts, Local Authorities, Counsel, CAFCASS, experts and other third parties.
- Attending Court and client meetings where appropriate.
- Maintaining accurate and well-organised client files and case records.
- Monitoring deadlines and supporting the progression of cases.
- Preparing Court bundles, hearing papers, briefing packs and other documentation.
- Assisting with Legal Aid applications and administration.
- Supporting client due diligence, AML and data protection requirements.
- Assisting with billing, time recording, disbursements and other administrative tasks.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues and supporting the wider team during busy periods.
- Keeping your knowledge up to date with relevant legal developments and procedural changes.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of delegated work, build your confidence and develop your career as your experience grows.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is organised, driven and genuinely passionate about delivering excellent client service.

You'll ideally have:
- A relevant legal qualification, such as a Law Degree, LPC, SQE or CILEX qualification, or relevant practical experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- A keen eye for detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional, approachable and compassionate manner.
- The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- The confidence to work independently while also being a strong team player.

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your legal career, gain valuable experience and make a real difference to clients, we'd love to hear from you.

Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm

COG LTD are acting as an Employment Agency.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
